items.text: The page has no h1 element. Every top-level section heading is an h2, including the hero headline.
items.evidence: facts.h1_count = 0; h2 count 14; first h2 is 'SPRING/SUMMER '21 AVAILABLE NOW'

items.text: The heading outline repeats 'BANDANA TOWELS', once as an h2 section heading and again as an h3 inside a card in the same section.
items.evidence: heading_outline: h2 'BANDANA TOWELS' followed by h3 'BANDANA TOWELS'

items.text: One font family, Helvetica Neue, is used for every measured element. There is no serif or display font.
items.evidence: fonts_by_element_count: [['Helvetica Neue', 202]]

items.text: The h2 headings are very large and heavy, set at 68px with weight 800 in all caps.
items.evidence: facts.h2 font_size 68px, font_weight 800; slices show 'BROWSE THE LATEST', 'IN THE PRESS', 'JOURNAL' in caps

items.text: Body text is 16px with a 24.8px line height, a ratio of 1.55.
items.evidence: body_font_size 16px, body_line_height 24.8px

items.text: Small eyebrow labels in widely tracked uppercase sit above most headings, for example 'NEW ARRIVALS', 'SUSTAINABILITY', 'MADE IN CANADA', '100% RECYCLED POLYESTER' and 'ULTRA SOFT MESH LINING'.
items.evidence: slice_00, slice_01, slice_02 eyebrow text above headlines

items.text: Button and link labels use small, letter-spaced uppercase text: 'SHOP NOW', 'VIEW', 'LEARN MORE', 'SHOP THE FULL COLLECTION', 'ALL POSTS'.
items.evidence: slices 00–04 button labels

items.text: A thin full-width black announcement bar at the very top holds centered white uppercase text: 'FREE SHIPPING ON ORDERS OVER $150 USD'.
items.evidence: slice_00 top band; rgb(17,17,17) appears among top_backgrounds

items.text: The header uses a three-part split. Text nav links (SHOP, ABOUT, JOURNAL, STOCKISTS) sit on the left, a centered script-style wordmark logo image sits in the middle, and SEARCH and CART text links sit on the right.
items.evidence: slice_00 header row; Bather-Logo.png at x=672, w=95, which is centered on the 1440px page

items.text: In the stitched screenshot, the header bar appears at about y=293, overlapping the hero gradient, while the DOM puts the logo at y=55. This suggests a fixed or sticky header that moved during capture.
items.evidence: facts logo rect y=55 vs slice_00 header row at ~293–357px with a blank white band above

items.text: The hero content is left-aligned. The large white headline wraps across four lines ('SPRING/SUMMER', ''21', 'AVAILABLE', 'NOW') and is followed by an outlined button.
items.evidence: slice_00 hero text block at left 48px

items.text: Every promotional tile uses the same outlined, square-cornered button style, in white on dark tiles and in black on light backgrounds ('SHOP ACCESSORIES', 'ALL POSTS').
items.evidence: slices 01, 02, 04

items.text: Corners are square almost everywhere. Only one element has a small radius, and none have a large or pill radius.
items.evidence: border_radius_buckets: bucket_0 201, bucket_1_7 1, others 0

items.text: Product and editorial tiles are flat color fields with no visible product photography. A bottom-to-top darkening overlay sits behind the text.
items.evidence: slices 00–02 tiles in sage, beige, orange, black and green fade darker at the bottom; facts.images lists only the logo, press logos, the 1%

items.text: Below the hero, a two-column split pairs a pale sage tile ('MADE WITH 100% RECYCLED MATERIALS') with a beige tile ('BEIGE HULA GIRL CAMP SHIRT'), each with text anchored at the bottom left.
items.evidence: slice_00 lower half, slice_01 top

items.text: The upper product tiles run edge to edge with no gutters between them. Later card grids ('BROWSE THE LATEST', 'JOURNAL') use visible gaps and side margins.
items.evidence: slice_01 tiles touch each other; slice_02 and slice_04 cards separated by ~48px and ~32px gaps

items.text: The 'BANDANA TOWELS' section sits on a warm off-white background with a centered eyebrow, heading and button, followed by two inset colored cards in orange and dark teal.
items.evidence: slice_01–02; rgb(244,239,230) and rgb(31,78,95) in top_backgrounds

items.text: The palette is earthy and warm: burnt orange rgb(232,100,58), deep teal rgb(31,78,95), forest green rgb(47,107,87), tan rgb(201,183,156) and cream rgb(244,239,230), set against near-black rgb(17,17,17) and white.
items.evidence: colors.top_backgrounds

items.text: Text color is near-black rgb(17,17,17) rather than pure black. White is the second most common text color, and grays (107,107,107 and 187,187,187) are used for secondary text.
items.evidence: top_text_colors: 17,17,17 ×97; white ×76; 107 gray ×22; 187 gray ×6

items.text: The 'BROWSE THE LATEST' section has a centered heading over three equal portrait cards (gray, taupe, tan). Each card has an eyebrow, a title, and an underlined text link instead of a boxed button.
items.evidence: slice_02 cards with 'LEARN MORE', 'BUY NOW', 'READ' underlined links

items.text: The press quotes are marked up as figure/blockquote/figcaption, with no cite elements.
items.evidence: semantic: figure 6, blockquote 6, figcaption 6, cite 0

items.text: Under the quotes, a white strip with slightly rounded corners holds six black-and-white publication logos in a row: Highsnobiety, GQ, NYT, Well Spent, Business Insider and The Globe and Mail.

items.text: 'OUR ETHOS' is a 50/50 split. The left half is a solid slate-gray block with no image content, and the right half holds a cream panel with a heading and two paragraphs.
items.evidence: slice_03 bottom, slice_04 top

items.text: The document title combines brand name and positioning with an em dash: 'Bather Trunk Co. — Surf & Swim, Made in Canada'.

items.text: The 'JOURNAL' heading is left-aligned, unlike the centered 'BROWSE THE LATEST' and 'IN THE PRESS' headings.

items.text: Journal titles use sentence or title case, which breaks from the all-caps headings used elsewhere.

items.text: The journal is laid out as three article cards. Each has a pastel color-block thumbnail (cream, pale mint, peach), a bold sentence-case h3 title, a gray excerpt truncated with an ellipsis, and an underlined 'READ MORE' link.

items.text: The footer is cream with three columns: 'ABOUT BATHER' (paragraph copy), 'MORE INFO' (a vertical list of links) and 'LET'S BE FRIENDS' (newsletter signup). Each column has a small tracked uppercase heading.
items.evidence: slice_04 bottom; footer h2s 'ABOUT BATHER', 'MORE INFO', 'LET'S BE FRIENDS'

items.text: Footer column headings are h2 elements styled small, so the same heading level appears at 68px in the body and at small size in the footer.
items.evidence: heading_outline lists footer titles as level 2; slice_04 shows small text

items.text: The newsletter form joins a square-cornered bordered email input directly to a solid black 'SUBSCRIBE' button. It is the page's only form, input and button element.
items.evidence: slice_04; tag_counts form 1, input 1, button 1, label 1

items.text: Social links (FACEBOOK, INSTAGRAM, PINTEREST, LIFESTYLE) are bold tracked uppercase text in a row, with no icons.
items.evidence: slice_05 top

items.text: A bottom bar below a thin divider holds an underlined gray copyright link on the left ('© 2021 Bather Trunk Company') and eight 38×24 payment-method icons on the right.
items.evidence: slice_05; payment SVG images at y=6709, each 38×24

items.text: The Apple Pay icon renders as a mostly blank white tile with a black top-edge stroke, unlike the other filled payment badges.
items.evidence: slice_05 second payment icon

items.text: The page has no external scripts or stylesheets. All CSS comes from a single inline style block plus 10 inline style attributes.
items.evidence: counts scripts 0, stylesheets 0; tag_counts style 1; inline_style_attrs 10

items.text: The page uses landmark elements: one header, nav, main and footer, plus 8 sections and 3 articles, with no aside.
items.evidence: semantic counts

items.text: The page is 6772px tall at 1440px wide and carries 519 words, so text is sparse relative to the large color-block areas.
items.evidence: layout page_height 6772, page_width 1440; text_stats words 519

items.text: Links far outnumber other interactive elements: 45 anchors against 1 button.
items.evidence: counts anchors 45, buttons 1

items.text: Section backgrounds alternate down the page: gradient hero, color tiles, cream, white, black press band, gray and cream split, white journal, cream footer.
items.evidence: slices 00–05 sequence of section backgrounds

items.text: The layout rests on a few horizontal margins. The nav and hero use 48px left padding, press and journal content sit in a 1200px container (x120–1320), the towel cards are narrower at x170–1270, and the footer starts at x70. Alignment edges therefore shift between sections.
items.evidence: Slices 0, 3, 4, 5 measurements: nav x48; press logos x136–1304; journal heading x118; footer x70

items.text: Copy is brand-voiced and short: headline fragments in caps ('MADE WITH 100% RECYCLED MATERIALS'), product names as titles, and a sustainability theme repeated in the tiles, ethos and footer through '1% for the Planet'.
items.evidence: Headings 'MADE WITH 100% RECYCLED MATERIALS', 'OUR ETHOS'; footer mention of 1% for the Planet

items.text: Text over the gradient tiles is white. On the light first tile (pale sage/grey) the white body copy and the small 'SUSTAINABILITY' eyebrow are faint against the pale background. Contrast depends on a bottom dark gradient overlay.
items.evidence: Slice 0 y≈1090–1300: 'SUSTAINABILITY' eyebrow and paragraph appear light on a pale grey-green fill; white text used 76 times

features.statement: Heading hierarchy skips h1: hero and all section headings are h2, with repeated heading text across levels.
A single sans-serif family is used throughout, with no serif or display font pairing.
Section headings are very large, extra-bold, all-caps type, around 68px at weight 800.
Body text uses 16px size with generous line height around 1.55.
Small widely tracked uppercase eyebrow labels sit above most headings.
Button and link labels are small, letter-spaced uppercase text.
A thin full-width black announcement bar with centered white uppercase text sits at the top.
Header is split three ways: text nav left, centered logo, utility text links right.
Header is fixed or sticky and overlays the hero content.
Hero content is left-aligned with a huge white multi-line headline followed by an outlined button.
Buttons are outlined with square corners, white on dark tiles and black on light backgrounds.
Corners are square almost everywhere, with no pill or large radii.
Promo tiles are flat color fields without photography, with a bottom darkening gradient overlay behind text.
Two-column split tiles anchor text at the bottom left of each tile.
Top tiles run edge to edge without gutters, while later card grids use visible gaps and margins.
Palette is earthy and warm, with burnt orange, teal, green, tan and cream against near-black and white.
Text uses near-black rather than pure black, with white on dark tiles and grays for secondary text.
Card grids use equal cards with eyebrow, title and underlined text link instead of boxed buttons.
Quotes use figure, blockquote and figcaption markup without cite elements.
A white strip holds a row of monochrome publication logos aligned on one baseline.
Section headings mix alignment, with some centered and some left-aligned.
Card titles use sentence case, contrasting with all-caps section headings.
Footer is a cream multi-column block with small tracked uppercase column headings, a newsletter signup and links.
Footer bottom bar pairs an underlined copyright link on the left with payment icons on the right.
Document title joins brand name and positioning with an em dash.
Page uses landmark elements (header, nav, main, footer, sections, articles) with inline styling and no external assets.
Section backgrounds alternate between color fields, cream, white and black down the page.
Alignment edges and container widths shift between sections rather than following one grid.
Copy is short and brand-voiced, with caps headline fragments and a repeated sustainability theme.
Links far outnumber buttons; interactive elements are mostly anchors.
